title: CollectionJob.results
description: Structured per-level result log for one collector run. Top-level keys are the three severity buckets; each holds an ordered list of entry objects appended by the tap_cares CollectorBase.record_* helpers. Each entry is the grid-sink form of the unified message object (req-tap-logging-message-object in specs/spec-tap-logging.md): same site/message_code/message/message_data fields, different sink.

site.description: 4-hex call-site token (e.g. 'a8f3'), minted via scripts/log-site-id. Identifies the line of code that emitted the entry; need only be unique within its file (the module namespaces it). Grep the hex to locate the callsite. See req-tap-logging-site-ids.

message_code.description: Machine-readable category in UPPER_SNAKE. Stable across runs and rewordings; what programmatic filtering / future Action rules key off, and the discriminator for the shape of message_data.

message.description: Human-readable run-specific prose. Includes specifics (counts, ratios, fragments) that vary per run; message_code stays stable while message describes the particular occurrence.

message_data.description: Free-form structured payload. Empty object when no extra data is needed. Collector-defined shape; consumers treat unrecognized keys as opaque unless they recognize message_code.
